_doc: One row per camo Snake can switch to with the C key. mgs_asset is a key in mgs_assets.json (the uniform's icon read from the player's MGS Delta install). Order is the picker order.

rows.name: Olive Drab
rows.blurb: Standard issue fatigues. Says 'soldier' in every language.

rows.name: Tiger Stripe
rows.blurb: Jungle stripes. Very loud in a classroom.

rows.name: Leaf
rows.blurb: Foliage pattern. Perfect for the school gardens.

rows.name: Splitter
rows.blurb: Angular brown splinters. Looks like a modern art piece.

rows.name: Raindrop
rows.blurb: East German rain pattern. Suspiciously local.

rows.name: Snow
rows.blurb: All white. Disappears against a hospital wall.

rows.name: Tuxedo
rows.blurb: A dinner jacket. For the ending of every spy film.

rows.name: Naked
rows.blurb: Shirtless. Scars, pecs and a bandana.
